verdict.rationale: AMD's Radeon ROCm docs cover the 9000 Series, and the PyTorch and JAX install pages name the RX 9070 XT (gfx1201). The same docs state vLLM has full support and llama.cpp is supported for inference, so the serving-stack half of the story is documented. Nothing in the pack covers FP8/FP4 low-precision inference for this part; the only precision mention is MIOpen bfloat16 for convolutions, which is a different format. Missing for 10: documented FP8/FP4 support on gfx1201, part-specific vLLM/llama.cpp validation beyond the general Radeon page, independent hands-on LLM inference corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, this GPU has a documented LLM inference story — low-precision formats (FP8/FP4) and supported serving stacks (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, ROCm, llama.cpp) for this part

citations.quote: ROCm™ 7.2.1 supports the latest Radeon™ 9000 Series (RDNA™ 4) and select 7000 Series (RDNA™ 3) GPUs
This page describes how to set up and run vLLM on AMD GPUs and APUs using either a prebuilt Docker image (recommended) or pip.
